evidence: Pinned RESULT.md complete proof and verify.py (Git blob SHA 6ab6e04488fcc4791d809f79d543bf3823a8edca); independent finite-field calculations and independent orbit enumeration.
Independent orbit+Groebner program independently recovered 9841 projective, 3504 rational-smooth, 56 pre-orbits, seven smooth orbit sizes [18,18,24,24,36,72,72], four full orbit sizes [36,36,48,144].

Exact nine-by-nine Hasse-Witt matrices and powers at seven source representatives yielded stable ranks 8 or 9, and independent polynomial coefficient reconstruction used F=P_X A+P_Y B in all four charts.
correctness.rationale: The normal form F=P_X A(Y)+P_Y B(X), with one syzygy gauge, has 9 ternary parameters and (3^9-1)/2=9841 projective equations. Direct enumeration found 3504 rationally nonsingular equations. An independently implemented GL2 generator action and four-chart characteristic-three Groebner singularity tests gave 56 factor-preserving rationally smooth orbits and precisely seven geometrically smooth orbits of sizes 18,18,24,24,36,72,72, totaling 264. Factor swap gives four full orbits of sizes 36,36,48,144. Independently computed nine-by-nine Cartier/Hasse-Witt coefficient matrices [x^(3i-k)y^(3j-l)] f^2 for seven representatives (6898,6904,6919,7858,7876,8344,8356); ranks and ninth-power stable ranks respectively (8,8,8,8,9,8,9). Thus exactly 216 cases have p-rank8/a=1, and the 48 ordinary ones form one full orbit; genus nine from adjunction. The independent orbit implementation required correction of an accidental projective normalization of generator columns, then produced the exact results; no failed interim computation was concealed.
